objects.text: Non-invasive saliva collection with zero sample preparation.
Non-invasive, zero-prep saliva collection that stabilizes DNA at room temperature for over a year.
Supports convenient self-collection without refrigeration and is suitable for home, clinic or field use.
Designed for molecular applications where simple collection and reliable DNA preservation are important.

Oral cancer and early
diagnostic research
Collect saliva using the ONESpit™ collection procedure.
Follow the kit instructions for completing collection and stabilization.
Secure the sample and maintain recommended storage conditions.
Transport without refrigeration when permitted by the validated instructions.
Use the preserved sample for downstream DNA extraction and molecular analysis.
DNA from 8 independent ONESpit™ saliva samples showed consistent, high-quality bands with no visible degradation. Supports DNA preservation for downstream molecular workflows.
